purpose: Compact rebase after poetry/Foundry regression and navigation confusion.

regression: A Jueju recovery branch was over-promoted into the product identity as Chinese Poetry Copilot.
The sealed Verse Atlas specialist was directly mutated by cross-product deep-link/open-draft behavior before that product shell was proven.
Poem Map 0.2 already existed but was not treated as the current authoring experiment during the detour.
Poem Map re-entered in MAP and exposed relation-law tuning early, increasing first-use cognitive load.
Poem Map RETURN exported state but did not replay it.
not_regression: Foundry's broader split is intentional: one path engine does not imply one poetry theory.
Pathweaver, Market+Solver, Grid Path, MEANTOME and Verse Atlas retain distinct jobs.
Poem Map 0.2 already contained locks, author paths, possibility intents, candidate bank, TRY→ADOPT, revision ancestry, form adapters and aperture.

verse_atlas.rule: Do not put general Verse product experiments inside this sealed specialist without a named missing function and a new regression receipt.

poem_map.verification: static JS parse + DOM selector integrity PASS; rendered browser smoke pending

current_play_path: Use TINY DEMO or paste your own source.
Stay in PAGE first and select one token.
Choose one writer intent or bank a manual alternative.
TRY previews without editing; ADOPT commits with ancestry; LOCK protects.
Open MAP or SETS only when relationship space is useful; author/capture paths optionally.
EXPORT and IMPORT to test RETURN.
laws: PAGE ≠ MAP ≠ SETS; they are unequal readings of one poem state.
Reachable/candidate text ≠ authored text until explicit ADOPT.
Forms constrain; they do not score poetry.
Jueju is an adapter/native specialist context, not the product identity.
Language/form changes should not require separate apps.
Do not add another view/provider/form before a real Poem Map use RETURN or concrete failure.
open: Rendered-browser smoke test for post-rebase Poem Map changes.
Real phonetic/language adapters; current SOUND and English syllable/rhyme are explicitly approximate.
Declarative form schema instead of hardcoded forms.
Optional line/macro-glyph overview for dense poems if it beats plain PAGE.
Game/challenge layer only if solved state remains the editable poem.
